SECTION C: OPTIMIZATION EVENT PROGRESSION ROADMAP & SWITCH TRIGGERS
>= 35 Bank Linked & >= 15 Trial Starts per Scaling Ad Set

Brand-new account has zero pixel history. Starting on Bank Linked filters out low-quality email leads while generating 116 events/day across the account (2.5x Purchase volume) with zero 7-day trial lag.
>= 50 Trial Starts/wk per Scaling Ad Set ($2,400+/wk spend)
Trial Start is the Golden Anchor Event: it fires Day 0, captures payment method + subscription intent, and hits 97–121 events/wk per Scaling Ad Set. Avoids the 7-day trial vs. 7DC attribution cliff.
Scaling Ad Set Spend >= $6,000/wk + CAPI Trial+Deposit Value Model

Raw Purchase occurs 7 days after Trial Start (outside 7DC for delayed activators). Instead of raw Day-8 Purchase, we test CAPI Value/Synthetic Purchase (Trial Start + Bank Deposit >= $50) vs. Trial Start.
